acceptance.requirement: All telemetry is deterministically derived from verified source events and receipts.
Model-pool cells remain independent by role, profile, risk, UI class and work shape.
Prompt and slice defects, runtime failure, missing first action and capability mismatch remain distinguishable.
First artifact and write latency, no-artifact operations, checkpoints and continuations are observable.
Internal fixes, legal continuations, independent rejects, landing retries and human wait do not collapse into one rework class.
Landing summaries retain source commit mapping, slice and reverification counts.
Source mutation, unmapped commits, mixed-member conflicts, receipt replay and force push fail closed.
Human summaries distinguish machine-owned work, required authority and post-decision reroute and verification.
All forbidden and missing human-request classes are detectable.
Human preference, wait, failure count and cost never become routing inputs.
Resource states are accepted only from the resource-lifecycle authority.
Telemetry performs no correctness, slicing or model-policy mutation.
The resource lifecycle contract is not extended or modified.
